name: Weekly Inverse-Vol Portfolio: SPY / TLT / GLD / DBC
description: Inverse-volatility weighted portfolio across SPY (equities), TLT (long bonds), GLD (gold), and DBC (commodities). Rebalances every Friday close. Each asset's weight = (1/vol_42d) / sum(1/vol_42d across all 4 assets). No position during the 42-bar warmup period. Fully invested at all times once vol is available. No stops — pure rotation strategy.
source:
# Weekly Inverse-Volatility Portfolio: SPY / TLT / GLD / DBC
#
# RULES:
#   - Universe: SPY, TLT, GLD, DBC (4 assets)
#   - Signal: 42-day rolling annualized historical volatility per asset
#   - Weighting: w_i = (1/vol_i) / sum(1/vol_j for all j)  [manual arithmetic]
#   - Rebalance: every Friday close (last trading day of week)
#   - No position during 42-bar warmup (vol not yet available)
#   - Fully invested at all times once vol is available
#   - No stops — pure rotation / risk-parity-lite strategy

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# --- Volatility (42-day rolling annualized) ---
# volatility() expects price levels directly (not returns) — outputs annualized decimal vol
vol_42d = volatility(period=42)(close)

# --- Rebalance trigger: last trading day of each week (typically Friday) ---
is_friday = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.week, boundary=BoundaryType.end)(index())

# --- Inverse-vol weight numerator: 1/vol per asset ---
# Guard: only compute when vol is valid (after 42-bar warmup)
inv_vol = where(is_valid(vol_42d) and vol_42d > 0, 1.0 / vol_42d)

# --- Cross-sectional sum of all inv_vol values (denominator) ---
# cs_agg runs across all 4 assets at each timestamp, summing their inv_vol
inv_vol_sum = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Sum)(inv_vol)

# --- Normalized inverse-vol weight per asset ---
# w_i = (1/vol_i) / sum(1/vol_j)  — sums to 1.0 across all 4 assets
inv_vol_weight = where(is_valid(inv_vol) and is_valid(inv_vol_sum) and inv_vol_sum > 0,
                       inv_vol / inv_vol_sum)

# --- Entry/exit gated to weekly rebalance ---
# Asset is "active" when it has a valid weight (vol warmup complete)
has_weight = is_valid(inv_vol_weight) and inv_vol_weight > 0

# Enter on Friday when weight is valid; exit on Friday when weight is no longer valid
enter_long = is_friday and has_weight
exit_long  = is_friday and not has_weight

# Hold position between rebalances
held = hold_until()(enter=enter_long, exit=exit_long)

# --- Execution: wiring order = zone → sizing ---
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)

# Position size = inv-vol weight × 100 (percent of equity)
# Rebalance only on Fridays — weights lock between rebalances
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(
    size=inv_vol_weight * 100,
    rebalance_on=is_friday
)
